profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I love building tech and solving problems!

My interests include artificial intelligence applications and research, startups, product, and data science. I also enjoy playing softball, lifting weights, reading, and exploring the great outdoors.

“The very best thing you can do for the world is to make the most of yourself.” 
- Wallace D. Wattles

positions.title: Insurance Adjuster
positions.description:
Traveled around the country handling home-insurance claims for several carriers including Farm
Bureau, and TWIA. Met with customers at their homes after natural disasters and discussed the
insurance process. Performed inspections of properties and used construction/restoration experience
to estimate the cost of repairing homes.

positions.title: Paralegal
positions.description:
Worked at a divorce/family law firm in the DFW metroplex as the only legal assistant. Duties
included; maintaining and organizing attorney schedules, receiving and submitting payment through
LawPay managed cases in various programs such as Clio and Microsoft Office Suite programs, and
communicated with clients, opposing attorneys, etc. through phone, email, and face to face.

positions.title: Aerospace Sales Representatitive
positions.description:
Used sales experience to manage existing and new accounts for the aerospace parts distributor.
Facilitated the expansion and improvement of the inventory management system.

company.name: AV-TECH INDUSTRIES INC, A Division of Fastenal

positions.title: 3D Environment Artist
positions.description:
Worked on the art team of a game design studio under the University of Arkansas. Used
communication and attention to detail to maintain asset consistency throughout the extensive
production pipeline. Found creative solutions to unique problems that each project posed. Used the
agile-scrum method to project timelines and meet project goals.

positions.title: Electronic Discovery Project Manager
positions.description:
D6 Consulting was an electronic discovery and forensic technology firm in Texas. As an electronic
discovery project manager, I oversaw the chain of custody on client data and worked with clients to
determine project deliverables. I also managed a team that analyzed, parsed, and organized discovery
data. The data my team worked on was then used in legal cases as evidence.
